title: Perry v. Command Performance — historical formation issue
shortTitle: Perry v. Command Performance — historical formation issue
summary: A remand examined whether a salon contract had formed before discriminatory refusal of service.
notes: The opinion arose under an interpretation of § 1981 that then distinguished making a contract from performance. The book immediately describes the 1991 statutory expansion.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 237–238. Open assigned page 237.
